execution.scope: Each precise25k immutable evaluated checkpoint fixes the completed training prefix. All source episodes including budget truncations retained. Adaptive repeated training draws are descriptive, not independent development evaluation or causal comparisons. Existing offline diagnostic uses float64 recomputation with actual duration discounts and per-update population-std normalization. Source rollout shards remain local pending owning first125k full-run delivery; no duplicate upload of checkpoints or observation arrays.

conservation_checks: Every completed update and episode accounted for. All25k actions per seed retained. Action counts, wins, truncations, immediate shovels, MC MSE/EV match training history; float64 offline advantages match actual float32 training means/std within recorded error.
interpretation: Descriptive on-policy training prefixes of changing policies and adaptive repeated tasks. Action-conditioned advantage means are associations, not intervention effects or gradients for action-type logits. Pooled MC EV mixes changing critics and must not be interpreted as final-checkpoint EV. Tiny exact-budget boundary updates are preserved with sample sizes and return variance, not omitted or treated as evidence of global critic collapse. Development learning/acceptance remain determined by frozen declared nodes.
next_action: Continue existing frozen three-initialization training to prescribed125k. No reward, architecture, entropy, task pool or boundary update mutation based on these observations.
